items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And so he coached Steve Allen on how to do all that stuff.

ctx.x: What was it like, didn’t you participate in “The Benny Goodman Story” — the film of that?
Um hum. Steve Allen played Benny Goodman.
Is that, what’s it like to do a film like that, is it you sit around and wait a lot?
